grades.lower_bound_mechanism: dyadic division + induction with parity integral (incomplete)
grades.notes: Correct closed form given. Lemma 1 (odd-rank value) is fully and correctly proved. Lemma 2 sets up induction well but its key insertion step rests on a nonsensical computation ('=0') and asserted matching, not an argument; r=n case also circular. Lemma 3 proves n=1 and the pairing case, but the large-a_1 inductive case has wrong instance size, scaling, parity mismatch, and wrong-direction inequality.
